meaning: An app on your phone that stores payment cards so you can pay with the phone.
clues: It is a way to pay for something.
It can keep a debit or credit card ready on a phone.
A shop may ask you to tap the phone on a card reader at the register.
The card details are set up before you try to pay.
It has two words and starts with D.

decoys.meaning: A bank app feature that lets you deposit a check using your phone.
A payment card loaded with money before you use it.
A bank service that lets you pay bills from your account online or in the bank's app.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Open Apple Wallet or Google Wallet with someone you trust and look for the option to add a card. Follow the bank's steps.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: A wallet kept your cards together. This phone version keeps a card ready when a store accepts phone payments.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Keep your phone locked, and only add a card you got from your own bank or card company.
